name: Simple Power Analysis
description: Acquisition and visual/manual analysis of power consumption traces from cryptographic and security-critical operations. Covers measurement setup (shunt resistor placement, decoupling bypass), single-trace analysis to identify algorithmic operations, distinguish conditional branches, and extract key-dependent patterns in implementations of RSA, ECC, AES, and other algorithms.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to power analysis techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the physical basis of power analysis and common leakage models
evidence: Can explain why CMOS circuits leak information through power consumption
Understands Hamming weight and Hamming distance leakage models
Aware of common SPA targets (RSA square-and-multiply, AES SubBytes)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Sets up power measurement and identifies operations in traces under supervision
evidence: Correctly installs a shunt resistor and configures the measurement chain on a training target
Captures aligned power traces using ChipWhisperer or equivalent platform
Identifies distinct cryptographic operations (encryption rounds, key schedule) in a power trace with guidance
Distinguishes conditional branches in RSA traces on a reference implementation

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs SPA on real targets and extracts key material from vulnerable implementations
evidence: Sets up power measurement on unfamiliar targets including shunt placement and signal conditioning
Extracts RSA private key bits from unprotected square-and-multiply implementations via SPA
Identifies countermeasure presence (blinding, shuffling, constant-time code) from trace inspection
Produces SPA assessment reports meeting lab quality standards on 3+ engagements

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs SPA on hardened targets; develops custom analysis scripts; mentors team
evidence: Applies advanced trace processing (filtering, alignment, pattern matching) to extract leakage from noisy environments
Assesses effectiveness of SPA countermeasures through practical analysis
Develops custom SPA analysis scripts and visualization tools for the lab
Mentors junior analysts on measurement setup and trace interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on SPA; develops novel techniques; publishes at CHES/COSADE level
evidence: Published research on novel SPA techniques or countermeasure analysis
Defines the lab's SPA methodology aligned with Common Criteria or EMVCo standards
Provides expert consultation on SPA resistance to silicon designers
Trains teams on advanced SPA techniques and trace interpretation

assessment_methods.description: Set up power measurement on a reference target, capture traces, and extract key-dependent information using single-trace analysis
Observe measurement setup technique, probe placement, and trace interpretation during a live SPA session

equipment: Shunt resistor (1-10 Ohm) or current probe (e.g., Tektronix CT-1) for power measurement
Low-noise amplifier for power measurement chain
